findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_skin_collections, get_item_store, get_item_store_history, get_rust_updates, search_servers, get_top_servers, get_recent_wipes, get_data_freshness, search_guides, resolve_steam_profile, get_inventory · Private data: get_skin, search_workshop, search_servers, get_top_servers, get_recent_wipes, get_server, get_data_freshness, compare_market, get_inventory · Public sink: get_rust_updates, get_skin_marketplace_history, get_inventory · Destructive: get_market_movers, list_loot_sources, get_loot_table, search_commands, get_building_piece, get_raid_costs, get_upkeep_rules, get_twitch_drops, calculate_raid_cost, get_inventory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_skin_collections, get_item_store, get_item_store_history, get_rust_updates, search_servers, get_top_servers, get_recent_wipes, get_data_freshness, search_guides, resolve_steam_profile, get_inventory · Private data: get_skin, search_workshop, search_servers, get_top_servers, get_recent_wipes, get_server, get_data_freshness, compare_market, get_inventory · Public sink: get_rust_updates, get_skin_marketplace_history, get_inventory · Destructive: get_market_movers, list_loot_sources, get_loot_table, search_commands, get_building_piece, get_raid_costs, get_upkeep_rules, get_twitch_drops, calculate_raid_cost, get_inventory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
